topic: How would the 0.25 dB passband loss affect link budget margins in low-noise satellite receiver frontends?
consensus_response: A 0.25 dB passband loss in low-noise satellite receiver frontends would compromise spectral efficiency due to increased link margin requirements. This could necessitate a boost in transmitted power or a reduction in data rate, potentially increasing latency. In challenging channel conditions, such as satellite-only coverage, service availability may be affected. To mitigate these effects, network and payload management strategies should balance data rate improvements with effective interference management to ensure reliable network operation.
